recipes.d: See where the Earth runs hot
recipes.about:
Ever wonder which volcanoes are running hot right now? Hotspots gives you a global view.

Hotspots turns NASA satellite observations of thermal activity into a minimalist map of the world's volcanoes.

Each known volcano gets its own little marker, sized according to the relative thermal activity detected by satellites.

Hotspots also checks the Smithsonian's Global Volcanism Program for reported ongoing eruptions. Volcanoes listed as erupting get a little ash plume, so you can tell them apart from volcanoes showing a heat signal alone.

As observations age, the markers fade, so you can see where activity has been spotted recently without drowning in data.

recipes.about:
Bring the dry office humor of the German TV series Stromberg to your TRMNL. This plugin displays random German-language quotes with the character's name, turning a spare corner of your dashboard into a regular dose of workplace satire. The quotes remain in their original German.

The layout supports all four TRMNL sizes: full screen, horizontal half, vertical half and quadrant. It adapts to TRMNL OG and TRMNL X in landscape and portrait orientation. Images keep their proportions, while text size adjusts to the quote length. Very long quotes may be shortened with an ellipsis in smaller views to keep the screen readable.

Install the plugin, add it to your playlist and enjoy. No API key, separate account or external setup is required. A new quote is fetched every 30 minutes by default; you can adjust the interval in TRMNL. Your display updates according to its playlist and device check-ins.

An independent fan-made plugin, with quotes supplied by the Stromberg API.

recipes.d: A window into the deep ocean
recipes.about:
A window into the abyss.
Turn your TRMNL into your personal window into the deep ocean. Abyss lets you peek into a fascinating corner of our planet: the deep Pacific. Explore hydrothermal vents on Axial Seamount, a methane seep at Southern Hydrate Ridge, and the Oregon Offshore seafloor. These are real research camera images from places most of us will never visit.

Choose your view
Cycle through all four cameras, choose a few favourites, or settle into one. Leave the camera selection empty to rotate through every published camera.

The default 15-minute refresh rotates your selected views. Images are processed every three hours from periodic recordings and snapshots. When a camera cannot update, its last good image stays on display.

Where are the cameras?
Four camera views across three research sites in the northeast Pacific. Both vent cameras are on Axial Seamount; the other cameras look across Southern Hydrate Ridge and the Oregon Offshore seafloor. All depths are approximate.

ASHES: Mushroom vent — about 1,540 m
On Axial Seamount, an active underwater volcano on the Juan de Fuca Ridge. This camera looks into the ASHES hydrothermal vent field, where hot fluids emerge from the volcanic seafloor.
Explore the research site · Detailed site map

International District: Tiny Towers — about 1,520 m
A second hydrothermal vent field on Axial Seamount. The Tiny Towers camera offers another view of the volcano's deep-sea habitat.
Explore the research site ·

recipes.about:
See the lowest reported pump prices near you, from the UK government's official Fuel Finder service. Enter a UK postcode, a search radius and a fuel grade: the screen ranks the three lowest reported prices within that straight-line radius, shows ties honestly, and adds the nearest reporting forecourt for context, together with the time the prices were last synced.

Prices are the pump prices forecourts report before any discounts or loyalty offers. Distances are straight-line, not driving distances. The plugin does not show whether a forecourt is open or has fuel in stock, and it does not estimate savings. Forecourts that do not report to Fuel Finder are not shown, and a forecourt whose reported location is more than 5 miles from its own postcode is placed at its postcode. If prices have not been updated for more than 30 minutes the screen says so instead of showing a leaderboard.

Spotted a wrong price? Report a discrepancy to Fuel Finder.

Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Postcode lookup by postcodes.io: contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right; Royal Mail data © Royal Mail copyright and database right; National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right. Your postcode is sent to the Petrol Prices UK service and postcodes.io only to find its coordinates; it is not logged or linked to your account.
